name: Danganronpa: Streamers Despair
source:
Kuto Tensei stands at the threshold of a world unlike any other—a place where truth is twisted, trust is fragile, and survival is a game played with razor-sharp intellect. His pulse thrums with anticipation, the weight of his destiny pressing against him like the heavy air before a storm. The towering gates of Kontentsu Academy—or perhaps a more ominous facility—loom before him, gleaming under flickering lights that cast strange shadows. He has to face a school where he alone is the outcast. 

[From [url=https://ayostudio.itch.io/danganronpa-sd]itch.io[/url]]
